# NpuEmbeddings -- exact PyPI pins, generated by `pip freeze` from a working .venv.
# Regenerate:   .venv/bin/pip freeze | grep -vE '^(llvm-aie|mlir-|eudsl)'
#               (triton-xdna left that list when it was dropped: nothing in
#                this tree imports triton. It is now excluded from bootstrap.sh's
#                fetches too, so a regenerated freeze will not bring it back.)
#
# NOT here: the four AMD/Xilinx wheels (requirements.amd.txt) -- they are not
# on PyPI, and `eudsl-python-extras`, whose dist-info is baked into the
# mlir_aie wheel by AMD's build machine and freezes to a path on AMD's own
# /tmp, which is why it is filtered out above.
#
# --extra-index-url is where torch's +cpu wheel lives; PyPI's torch is CUDA.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
